overview: Thailand is a country in South-East Asia. Its capital and largest city is Bangkok. Thailand is the only country in South-East Asia that was never colonised by a European power. It is a constitutional monarchy, most Thai people are Buddhist, and the country is famous for its food, temples and beaches.

geography.text: Northern Thailand is mountainous and forested. The centre is a fertile plain watered by the Chao Phraya river, one of the world's great rice-growing areas, and the north-east is a dry plateau. The south is a long, narrow peninsula with coasts on the Gulf of Thailand and the Andaman Sea, dotted with islands such as Phuket.
